normalization.generated_placeholder: use query parameter requested and discard the /__offline wrapper
normalization.ordinary_local_url: map 127.0.0.1:8765 or localhost to http://www.worldofwarcraft.com while preserving path and query
normalization.raw_3848_note: The 3848 value is the number of distinct raw placeholder URLs after only extracting in-scope events; it is not the normalized resource-target count.

coverage_limits: An empty local CDX index is not treated as proof of no capture.
A target with only CDX rows has evidence of indexing but no local entity evidence.
HTTP/HTTPS grouped evidence is reported separately from exact-host/path/query matches.
Approved/source maps are local evidence only; this report does not modify or approve any resource.
